title: RecFlex: Enabling Feature Heterogeneity-Aware Optimization for Deep Recommendation Models with Flexible Schedules
problem: Industrial recommendation models have heterogeneous embedding computation workloads across feature fields, but existing solutions apply identical schedules to all fields, leading to suboptimal performance. Different feature fields require varied optimal code schedules for efficient execution.
motivation: Optimizing embedding computation is critical for industrial recommendation systems that process numerous feature fields.
method: RecFlex generates fused kernels with distinct schedules for different feature fields using an interference-aware schedule tuner and heterogeneous schedule fusion compiler. It employs a two-stage interference-simulated tuning strategy to determine optimal schedules for each field within the fused kernel. To handle dynamic workloads, RecFlex combines compile-time schedule tuning with runtime kernel thread mapping.
key_novelty: Generating heterogeneous fused kernels with feature-field-specific schedules instead of applying uniform schedules across all fields.
contributions: Interference-aware schedule tuner that optimizes distinct schedules for different feature fields
Heterogeneous schedule fusion compiler that generates fused kernels with multiple schedules
Two-stage interference-simulated tuning strategy for determining optimal per-field schedules
Runtime kernel thread mapping mechanism to handle dynamic workloads

metrics.speedup: 2.64x over TorchRec, 20.77x over HugeCTR, 11.31x over RECom

primary_theme: Heterogeneous schedule optimization for recommendation model embeddings
